answer: Each name is charged £18 per docket, and 120 dockets before the first reward is released, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. A name without Commonbound drain digger glebe licence is turned away at the counter, and a licence diggers carry after field inspections is the reason the counter can tell. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. voyage is written on the receipt. One violet, one entry.
